hooks: Yard work is always waiting: muck out the stable, split wood, mend a drover's harness. Tam will gladly share it, and the gossip that comes with it.
He knows the back ways: the inn's back door, the lane behind the forge, the goat track round the square. For a copper he shows them.
Some nights he has seen carts come up the west road with no lamps and turn off toward the old adit. He has told no one but would tell someone brave.

concerns.text: Be taken seriously by the grown men in the yard
